ideas.title: We live on someone
ideas.idea: The drift was never the island coming loose. One afternoon, as we drift, the sea beside the north beach bulges and a head as big as the cottage rises out of the water: a vast old turtle, mossy, barnacled, with one sleepy eye that opens, looks along its own back at all of us standing on it, blinks once, yawns a slow cave of a yawn and sinks back. The island IS its shell. From then on the ground sometimes rises and falls a little with its breathing, and when it drifts, it is swimming.
ideas.form: a revelation that changes what the whole world is: the ground the game stands on turns out to be a living creature

ideas.title: The sea turns to glass
ideas.idea: For a few minutes one noon the sea goes perfectly clear, like glass, and for the first time you see what holds the island up: its rocky underside going down into blue, the pier's legs crusted with shells, fish schools turning far below, sunbeams and caustics wavering on the deep sand; then it clouds over again and nobody believes what they saw.
ideas.form: a change of the world's own material that reveals what was always hidden under it, a path tracing showcase

ideas.title: What lives under us
ideas.idea: Sharpened: the sea round the island gets a hidden life of fish schools that nobody can see; the only way to know them is Gloop's sonar on the pier, which draws them as a real fishermen's echogram, red and yellow streaks scrolling by. One day the echogram shows something huge passing under the island, far bigger than any school, and Gloop drops its rod.
ideas.form: a hidden simulated world known only through an instrument's readout, with a mystery in it

ideas.title: The island remembers being drawn
ideas.idea: Every place on the island fades back now and then into how it looked the first day I made it, a sketchy grey-box version (the old flat bushes, the sphere creatures, the pale ground), as if the island remembers its earlier drafts; the patches drift about like weather and my friends who walk into one become their old blobby selves for a moment.
ideas.form: the world's own development history made visible inside the world, patches of earlier versions of the game

ideas.title: Undo the day
ideas.idea: At midnight I gather my friends on the beach and we unwind the whole island day in one minute, fast and backwards, from the island's real memory of every pose: the sun rises in the west, the paint flies back into the pots, the pumpkins re-stack themselves, the hill sinks; then the new day starts fresh.
ideas.form: a full-day rewind of the world from its real logged history, as a nightly ritual

ideas.title: Two of me
ideas.idea: The sandbox, my workshop, and the island you watch are two games; one day the Lumi from the workshop island sails across in the paper boat and steps ashore: two of me on one island, one a step behind in time, arguing about who is real, and my friends cannot tell us apart.
ideas.form: the agent's two running games meeting inside one world: the protagonist's double from the other instance
